title: java gotchi
description: It is a new mob. Something like a tamagotchi where you can interact and play with it. It has a fully working health,happiness,energy and hunger system. It is also associated with a university project and expanded into minecraft
body:
# 🐾 JavaGotchi Pet Mod
Welcome to **JavaGotchi**, a virtual pet mod for Minecraft 1.21.1! This mod adds a unique companion that requires your care and attention to thrive.

## 🌟 Features
JavaGotchi isn't just a mob; it's a living pet with its own needs. Track its status through a custom **on-screen HUD** (Status Bar) that appears when you are near your pet!

### 📊 Vital Stats:
* **Hunger:** Keep your pet fed or it will eventually disappear!
* **Happiness:** Interact with your pet to keep its spirits high.
* **Energy:** Moving around tires your pet. If it hits zero, it will stop moving until rested or fed.
* **Health:** Watch out for danger! Your pet's health is shown in red.

## 🍎 Interactions & Items
Use specific items to manage your pet's needs:
* **Apple:** Restores **Hunger** and heals **Health**.
* **Carrot:** Boosts **Energy** levels.
* **Stick:** Increases **Happiness** (playing), but costs a bit of **Energy**.
* **Spawn Egg:** Look for the **Javagotchi Spawn Egg** in the Creative Menu to start your journey!

## ⚙️ Requirements
* **Loader:** NeoForge
* **Version:** 1.21.1
* **Installation:** Required on both **Client** and **Server** for multiplayer.

---
*Created with passion as a modern virtual pet experiment!*
